change: Skip copy propagation when the source and destination name the same physical register. Rewriting identical operands is not progress. Retain the instruction for width-aware cleanup; do not delete narrowing self-copies.
measurement_source: Frozen baseline at base_commit and candidate at that base plus this commit's machine/simplify.go change. Both test binaries include the new benchmark and test fixture files, which were added before freezing the baseline. Only benchmark functions were run for timing.
scope: A pathological simplifier stall and an ordinary 128-copy control. BLAKE3 emission is a separate single before/after observation, not an established general compiler speedup. No hash-runtime timing or speedup claim; generated C and the native object are identical.

platform.limitations: Busy shared host with uncontrolled frequency and scheduling. Load sampled per invocation. No builds or tests from this experiment overlapped timing. Only one before/after BLAKE3 emission pair; no confidence interval or general wall-time multiplier.

bug_reproduction.description: Both pre-fix target regressions exhausted 1024 rounds while leaving a later useful copy unchanged. These failures were intentional pre-fix observations. The narrowing self-copy regression passed before and after.

reproduction: Start at base_commit. Copy this commit's machine/simplify_test.go and machine/webs_benchmark_test.go into the baseline checkout, leaving production code unchanged. Build go test -c ./machine and go build ./benchmarks/native/emit into an unused scratch directory.

Apply only this commit's machine/simplify.go change and freeze the after binaries. Run the benchmark command with before/after/after/before binaries, retaining raw samples and sysctl -n vm.loadavg before and after each invocation.

Run the emission command before then after with distinct prefixes, fresh verdicts and the normal proof budget. Preserve stdout, stderr, time counters and load; compare .c and .o bytes and require all eight result chunks freshly Proven. Keep experiment builds/tests outside timings.
